title: Maria's Job
text:
My aunt is a doctor. She works at a big hospital in the city. Every day, she helps sick people and makes them feel better. She wakes up early and goes to work by bus.

My uncle is a teacher. He works at a school near our house. He teaches math to children. In the afternoon, he likes to read books and cook dinner for his family.

questions.text: What can we guess about Maria's aunt?
options: She does not like her job
She works hard to help people

questions.text: What can we guess about Maria's uncle's free time?
options: He enjoys hobbies and time with family

vocabulary.definition: a person whose job is to treat sick people
a large building where sick people get medical care
a person who teaches students in a school

paragraph_translations: Mi tía es médica. Trabaja en un gran hospital de la ciudad. Todos los días ayuda a personas enfermas y las hace sentir mejor. Se despierta temprano y va al trabajo en autobús.
Mi tío es maestro. Trabaja en una escuela cerca de nuestra casa. Enseña matemáticas a los niños. Por la tarde, le gusta leer libros y cocinar la cena para su familia.
